name: AI Study Coach
tagline: Turn class notes into study plans, revision guides, and linked quizzes.
description: AI Study Coach turns your course material into a practical learning workflow. Upload or paste notes, save them to your note history, and ask for source-grounded summaries, concept explanations, or answers. Use saved notes to generate a multi-week study plan or a multiple-choice quiz linked to its source. Track quiz scores, review correct answers and explanations, and personalize your daily study target with a saved study profile. Supports text-based PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and JSON files. Text is extracted locally in the browser and sent to Anna only when you request an AI action; scanned PDFs are not supported.
